openClinicalQuestions: Confirm whether WHD asks for a urine test before accepting a frequency complaint into physiotherapy.

claimLedger.claim: Needing to pee more often or suddenly, with pain on peeing, can be a urine infection.
claimLedger.limitations: Infection page; not all frequency is infection.

claimLedger.claim: Urgency incontinence is a sudden need to pee, distinct from leaks on coughing.
claimLedger.limitations: Describes leakage types after infection is considered.
